newsitem.title: INDIA: India to urge RBI to ease loan terms for airlines.
newsitem.headline: India to urge RBI to ease loan terms for airlines.

text.p: Civil Aviation Minister C.M. Ibrahim will urge the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) to ease guidelines governing financial institutions' loans to private airlines, government officials said on Wednesday.
"The minister will ask RBI to ease the loan facilities by financial institutions to private airlines," a Civil Aviation Ministry official said.
The decision was taken at a meeting between Ibrahim and private airline operators, said the official, who did not elaborate.
The Press Trust of India (PTI) said the RBI was expected to review the guidelines within a month.
Civil Aviation Ministry officials said the present policy of the RBI is to grant term loans of not more than five billion rupees ($140 million) per project.
